text:
Priya: heads-up: running a small docs churn to close a handful of link + snippet nits for KV-cache and runtime examples. plan is to ship 3 tiny PRs today.
Sam O: can do one. which files are in scope?
Priya: files I spotted: content/runtime/kv-cache/overview.md, content/runtime/kv-cache/ops.md, content/runbooks/kvcache-troubleshoot.md, and scripts/examples/send-curl.sh (external endpoint moved).
Nate: quick ownership check: are any of these mid-edit? i don't want to stomp someone.
Iris: i maintain kvcache runbooks but i'm out till tomorrow morning. happy to hand off a small patch if someone else takes it.
Priya: thanks Iris. propose: Sam -> overview.md, Nate -> ops.md, Iris -> runbook handoff before leaving (tiny frontmatter note), and i'll take the curl script.
Sam O: ok i'll sweep for anchor fragments and update headings to stable IDs. will add redirects in frontmatter where anchors previously broke.
Nate: i'll remove internal shortlinks that point to deprecated fragments and replace with full-path anchors. will include a quick unit check.
Priya: docs-bot shows 4 alerts: 3 internal anchors + 1 external 404. please link commits to the alert IDs.
docs-bot: alert 4337: runtime/kv-cache anchors (3), alert 4338: scripts/examples/send-curl.sh external 404. re-scan scheduled after merges.
Sam O: estimated 25m for my edits. tagging PR with `docs:kv-cache` and requesting Nate for review.
Nate: can review fast. prefer single-file PRs to keep diffs tiny.
Iris: i'll add an "ownership: Iris" line in the runbook header before handing to Sam or Nate if needed.
Priya: i'll collect the PR links into a meta issue and do a canary docs deploy after merges. docs-bot please re-run the link check on merge.
docs-bot: will re-run. will comment with validation output. :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks everyone — posting PRs in ~40m. if you see lingering 404s after merge, ping #eng oncall.
Sam O: roger that.
Nate: thumbs up.
Priya: :tada:
